text:
Ava M: Heads up — marketplace build team wants to pin a driver/CUDA/ROCm stack for the next marketplace artifact. Need partner signoff for SI air-gapped installs and a plan if regressions show up.

Ravi K: What failures are we seeing on CUDA 12.3? I noticed a KV-cache throughput drop on A100 in our perf runs.

Nina P: Reproduced. Continuous-batching throughput drops ~5-7% at seq_len 4096. I put raw perf logs in the artifacts link: https://redwood.internal/ci/2468/perf.

Ben (Partner Eng): Partner X reported kernel oops on Ubuntu 22.04 with nvidia 535.12 on their staged nodes. They can repro with our image + model set.

Carlos (Marketplace): If we ship with 535.12 and there's an oops for customers, marketplace support load will spike. Can we delay the public announcement until we validate a hotfix?

Ava M: Proposal: 1) Run a 48h canary on Dedicated using the candidate artifact, pinned stack. 2) If canary passes, publish marketplace package pinned to the hotfix driver. 3) Provide a fallback marketplace variant pinned to CUDA 11.8 + driver 520.x for customers who need immediate stability.

Ravi K: +1. I'll schedule the canary to start today at 17:00 PT and route ~10% of internal traffic. InfraBot will run the smoke+perf harness.

InfraBot: Preflight queued: docker build (sha: ab12cd), smoke tests, regression harness (job 7892). Estimated runtime 2h.

Nina P: Quick update from tests: smoke ok, but perf regression confirmed (~6% throughput drop). I'm bisecting kernel parameters and driver flags now.

Ben (Partner Eng): Partner X said they can validate a kernel param tweak tomorrow morning in their staging fleet. They'll report back by 10:30 PT.

Ava M: If the kernel tweak recovers perf we ship 535.12-hotfix. If not, we do the fallback variant and open a postmortem + mitigation plan.

Carlos (Marketplace): I'll hold the marketplace publish and the joint announcement. I'll draft release notes and a customer advisory that explains the pinned artifact + fallback. We should also update our private deployments doc for SI air-gapped install steps.

Ravi K: Action items recap: @Ravi run canary and monitor, @Nina continue RCA, @Ben coordinate partner validation, @Carlos hold announcement and prep notes. Check-in at EOD (23:00 UTC).

Ava M: Pinned versions for the candidate artifact (working draft):
```
- driver: 535.12-hotfix
- CUDA: 12.3
- ROCm: 5.6
- fallback: CUDA 11.8 + driver 520.x
```

Ava M: Also note for SI teams: produce immutable artifact (sha + provenance) and provide kernel diff patch if we go with tweak path. Partners will need the airgap bundle and a short runbook.

Ben (Partner Eng): I'll collect partner validation timelines and post them here.

Carlos (Marketplace): I'll gate the public announcement until we have partner signoff or the fallback published.

InfraBot: Canary started at 2468001200, canary ID canary-2468. Monitoring hooks attached.

Nina P: Will post test artifacts and final recommendation before EOD.

Ava M: Thanks all — staying in thread for updates.
